results.title: Rob Schofield: State continues to be ruled, held back by party of fear
results.description: It would be silly to claim that there aren’t a lot of things in the modern world about which to be deeply concerned or even, at times, fearful.

results.title: Mayor backs calls for Yorkshire army college inquiry after reports of rape and abuse
results.description: North Yorkshire’s deputy mayor for policing, fire and crime has backed calls for an inquiry to be held into an military training college in Harrogate after reports of rape and sexual abuse against female recruits.

results.title: 'Not everyone can manage': Longer walk to National Railway Museum divides visitors
results.description: The longer walk to York's National Railway Museum during upgrade works has sparked debate, with some visitors raising concerns about accessibility.
